Requirement: Understand the organisation and its context: internal and external issues, including whether climate change is relevant (Amd 1:2024)
Current state: Context exists only as CGI-RSK-001 assumptions A-01 to A-06 (GV.OC = 1).
Gap: No approved context statement; climate change not considered.
Evidence needed: Approved context and issues statement.

Requirement: Interested parties, their relevant requirements, and which of those the ISMS addresses
Current state: Customers, a GDPR supervisory authority and vendors are known across CGI-POL-005 and CGI-TPR-001.
Gap: No interested-parties register; no decision on which requirements the ISMS addresses.
Evidence needed: Interested-parties and obligations register (with A.5.31).

Requirement: Determine and document the ISMS scope, considering interfaces and dependencies with other organisations
Current state: Drafted in CGI-ISO-001 section 2 (this document).
Gap: Not approved by top management.
Evidence needed: CEO-approved scope statement v1.0.

Requirement: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the ISMS
Current state: Components exist (policies, register, gap assessment, vendor programme) but do not run as one system.
Gap: No ISMS manual or process map linking them.
Evidence needed: ISMS overview showing how the clauses 4-10 processes connect.

Requirement: Leadership and commitment
Current state: The CEO approved CGI-POL-001 to -005, CGI-RSK-001, CGI-GAP-001 and CGI-TPR-001.
Gap: The USD 32,100 year-one budget is costed but unapproved (GAP-003); no stated commitment to the ISMS.
Evidence needed: Approved budget; ISMS policy signed by the CEO.

Requirement: Information security policy: appropriate, provides a framework for objectives, commits to requirements and continual improvement; documented and communicated
Current state: Five topic-specific policies are approved.
Gap: No top-level ISMS policy meeting 5.2 a) to d).
Evidence needed: ISMS policy v1.0, communicated and acknowledged.

Requirement: Roles, responsibilities and authorities, including for ISMS conformance and reporting to top management
Current state: Document-level owners exist (GV.RR = 2).
Gap: No one is assigned to ensure ISMS conformance or report its performance.
Evidence needed: Written assignment of an ISMS lead; RACI.

Requirement: Determine risks and opportunities for the ISMS itself and plan actions
Current state: None.
Gap: ISMS-level risks and opportunities have never been considered (distinct from information security risks).
Evidence needed: Short ISMS risks and opportunities record.

Requirement: Information security risk assessment process, including risk ACCEPTANCE criteria and criteria for performing assessments
Current state: CGI-RSK-001 applies a documented NIST SP 800-30 5x5 method and has operated twice (v1.0, v1.1). ID.RA = 3.
Gap: No risk acceptance criteria or appetite (GAP-002), so ACC-001 and ACC-V01 were accepted against nothing. No defined re-assessment cadence.
Evidence needed: CEO-approved risk acceptance criteria; assessment cadence.

Requirement: Risk treatment: select options, determine controls, compare with Annex A, produce the SoA and a risk treatment plan, and obtain risk owners' approval and residual acceptance
Current state: Four treatment options applied; TP-01 to TP-10 costed; SoA drafted here (93 controls).
Gap: SoA and consolidated RTP not approved; residual High risks (R-004, R-005, VR-004) not formally accepted by their owners.
Evidence needed: Approved SoA v1.0; approved RTP; signed residual-risk acceptances.

Requirement: Information security objectives: measurable, monitored, communicated; plans to achieve them
Current state: 14 KRIs exist in CGI-RSK-001 v1.1.
Gap: KRIs are indicators, not objectives. No objectives are set.
Evidence needed: Objectives with owners, targets and dates.

Requirement: Planning of changes to the ISMS
Current state: None.
Gap: No rule for making ISMS changes in a planned way.
Evidence needed: Change-planning step in the ISMS procedure.

Requirement: Resources
Current state: The budget is estimated in CGI-RSK-001.
Gap: Not approved; no allocation of staff time to the ISMS.
Evidence needed: Approved budget and time allocation.

Requirement: Competence, with documented evidence
Current state: None on file.
Gap: No competence requirements for ISMS roles and no evidence of competence.
Evidence needed: Role competence matrix; training and certificate records.

Requirement: Awareness of policy, contribution and implications of non-conformance
Current state: Induction 60% complete; 60% acknowledgement.
Gap: Not all staff reached; no recurring programme (CG-04).
Evidence needed: 100% acknowledgement; REC-09 curriculum records.

Requirement: Internal and external communication
Current state: Policies published; CGI-POL-005 defines incident communications.
Gap: No ISMS communication plan (what, when, with whom, how).
Evidence needed: Communication plan.

Requirement: Documented information: creation, updating and control
Current state: Every CGI policy has a document control block (version, owner, review date).
Gap: No procedure controlling records; no document register.
Evidence needed: Document and record control procedure; ISMS document register.

Requirement: Operational planning and control, including control of externally provided processes
Current state: The CGI-TPR-001 workflow controls externally provided services.
Gap: Other operational processes are not planned or evidenced.
Evidence needed: Operating records for the RTP actions.

Requirement: Perform risk assessments at planned intervals or on significant change; retain results
Current state: Performed September 2026 (v1.0) and again on change (v1.1 vendor addendum); results retained.
Gap: The planned interval is not yet defined (recorded under 6.1.2).
Evidence needed: Next scheduled assessment record.

Requirement: Implement the risk treatment plan; retain results
Current state: CGI-TPR-001 executed (CG-06 closed); AVD-001 and ACC-001 in force.
Gap: Most RTP actions not started (Wave 1 due Q4 2026).
Evidence needed: Treatment status tracker with evidence per action.

Requirement: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation; retain results
Current state: 14 KRIs defined; KRI-V1 measured once (65%).
Gap: No monitoring programme; results not reported (GV.OV = 1).
Evidence needed: Quarterly KRI and objective report.

Requirement: Internal audit at planned intervals
Current state: None.
Gap: No internal audit has ever been performed. There is no REC for it in CGI-GAP-001 (see RC-03).
Evidence needed: Completed internal audit of all clauses and applicable controls before Stage 1.

Requirement: Internal audit programme: frequency, methods, responsibilities, criteria and scope; auditor objectivity; results reported
Current state: None.
Gap: No programme; no independent auditor identified.
Evidence needed: Audit programme; audit plan; audit report.

Requirement: Management review at planned intervals
Current state: None. No security item has appeared on a leadership agenda (GAP-005).
Gap: Never held.
Evidence needed: Minutes of management review #1 (Mar 2027) and #2 (Jun 2027).

Requirement: Management review inputs a) to g), including changes in interested parties' needs
Current state: None.
Gap: The REC-10 agenda (KRIs, scorecard, TP status) omits several 9.3.2 inputs (see RC-02).
Evidence needed: Agenda template covering 9.3.2 a) to g).

Requirement: Management review results: improvement decisions and changes; documented
Current state: None.
Gap: Never held.
Evidence needed: Minutes with decisions and actions.

Requirement: Continual improvement
Current state: Improvement happens through commissioned projects (ID.IM = 1).
Gap: No routine improvement loop.
Evidence needed: Improvement log fed by audits, KRIs, incidents and exceptions.

Requirement: Nonconformity and corrective action (correction, root cause, action, effectiveness review); retained
Current state: CGI-POL-005 section 5.7 covers incident corrective actions only (a fragment).
Gap: No nonconformity process; exceptions (EXC-001 to -003) are not nonconformities.
Evidence needed: NC and corrective action procedure and log.
